name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.ekyb.EKYBActivity
description: When a flow verifies a business, this screen collects business details such as its name, country, address, and tax number, then submits them for checking. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents business-verification flows from collecting and submitting the required details.
